cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, os, random
rng = random.Random(11)
plan = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/maxplan.json'))['probes']
# long lines: build a row padded with whitespace to 4095 chars + LF = 4096
def long_row(p, total):
    s = json.dumps({"probe_id":p['id'],"received_ms":p['sent_ms'],"target":p['target'],"source":p['target'],"type":129,"code":0}, separators=(',',':'))
    padlen = total - len(s) - 1
    assert padlen >= 1
    return s + ' ' * padlen
r = long_row(plan[0], 4096)
assert len(r) + 1 == 4096
open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/line4096.jsonl','w').write(r + '\n')
open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/line4097.jsonl','w').write(long_row(plan[0], 4097) + '\n')
# exactly 96 MiB total with many lines
target = 96*1048576
rows = []
size = 0
i = 0
while size < target - 5000:
    p = plan[i % len(plan)]
    s = json.dumps({"probe_id":p['id'],"received_ms":p['sent_ms'],"target":p['target'],"source":p['target'],"type":129,"code":0}, separators=(',',':'))
    want = min(4096, target - size - len(s) - 1)
    if want < len(s) + 2:
        break
    line = s + ' '*(want - len(s)) if want > len(s) else s
    rows.append(line); size += len(line) + 1; i += 1
# pad the last line to land exactly on target
need = target - size
if need > 0:
    rows[-1] = rows[-1] + ' '*(need-1) if need >= 1 else rows[-1]
size = sum(len(x)+1 for x in rows)
print('exact size', size, 'lines', len(rows))
open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/exact96.jsonl','w').write('\n'.join(rows) + '\n')
print(os.path.getsize('/workspace/tmp/t/work/exact96.jsonl'))
EOF
